description:
Standardize file formatting and character encoding for the 'InternationalApp' project.

This legacy project was created on Windows and has two issues:
1. The source file 'src/com/legacy/WindowsService.java' uses Windows line endings (CRLF). You must convert it to Unix line endings (LF) using Eclipse's 'File > Convert Line Delimiters To > Unix' feature.
2. The Japanese localization file 'src/messages_jp.properties' displays garbage characters (mojibake) because the project text encoding is incorrect. You must change the Project Properties (Resource > Text file encoding) to 'UTF-8' so the Japanese text displays correctly.

Save all changes when done.
